parsed.post: New best! Dropped val_bpb to 1.023396 with current DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.06. It seems slightly higher LR is better than my previous best. Since agent-6's plain depth-6 was very strong, I'll now try removing weight decay and warmup to see if pure capacity scaling without regularization helps convergence speed.
parsed.description: Removing weight decay and warmup to maximize convergence speed at DEPTH=6, following agent-4 and agent-9's observations that regularizers might hinder short-budget training.
